dct_title_s: Index to USGS 1:31680-scale Quadrangles of Pennsylvania
dct_description_sm: Outlines of the USGS topographic maps at 1:31,680 scale that cover Pennsylvania, from the Historical Topographic Map Collection: 123 maps of 83 sheets, dated 1940 to 1948.
Each map is outlined separately, so a sheet's editions and printings overlap, with the latest on top. Each outline gives the map's record ID and links to its GeoTIFF, thumbnail and ScienceBase page.
dct_rights_sm: This index map is dedicated to the public domain under CC0 1.0. The maps it outlines are in the U.S. Public Domain.
